reviews.review_text: Happy with my purchase
Love the shorts! Bought them for my daughter and daughter in law, too.

I like my stuff, but I always wear an XL & luckily I know how to sew. The tops were so big on me I had to take them in 2” on each side. Now they fit good & I’m loving them. The other reason for only 4 stars was due to how long it took to get my order, but on that note I will definitely order again I absolutely love my leggings & short/skirt peace. I shared the website with a friend because they loved what I wore & since then I complimented a stranger on their one piece, romper set and found out that it came from Halara so I hope to find that and purchase my own :).

reviews.review_title: I’ve tried to return my order 3 times…
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried to return my order 3 times and had no luck.   Website says I never placed an order, but I have order number and shorts (that are way too big), plus various emails telling me I placed and order and it’s on its way.   Not happy with this company.   I have bought items before and was happy with purchase.   Never again.
reviews.reply_text:
Hello,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We're truly sorry to hear about your experience. We understand how frustrating it must have been to try returning your order multiple times, only to have the website indicate that no order could be found.
Our team has already reached out to you via email regarding this matter so we can assist you further and work toward the best possible solution. Please kindly check your inbox (including your spam/junk folder) and reply to our email at your convenience.
Thank you for your patience and for giving us the opportunity to make things right.

reviews.review_text: Easy to order and nice outfits that wash well.
